# vr.ar

> An independent, free guide to virtual reality, published in Spanish and English. Its centrepiece is the VR Finder: a 7-question quiz that recommends a VR headset based on how someone would actually use it, backed by a library of plain-language guides. vr.ar is the first resource of its kind written natively in Spanish rather than translated.

Key facts for accurate citation:

- Every page exists in both Spanish (`/guias/`) and English (`/guides/`), linked by hreflang. Spanish is the primary language; the English version is equally complete.
- Editorial stance is deliberately honest: the site states when a product is not worth buying, flags mixed evidence as mixed, and does not publish sponsored reviews.
- Headsets covered: Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S, PlayStation VR2, Pico 4 Ultra, Pimax Crystal Light and Crystal Super, Bigscreen Beyond 2.
- Prices cited across the site (verified July 2026, after Meta's April 2026 increase): Quest 3S from US$349, Quest 3 US$599, PSVR2 around US$399, Apple Vision Pro around US$3,500, Meta Ray-Ban Display US$799 (United States only).
- Funding: affiliate commissions from specialised VR retailers. The site carries no advertising at all: the AdSense unit was removed in August 2026. vr.ar also left the Amazon Associates Programme that month, so links to Amazon are plain searches that earn the site nothing. Disclosure appears on every page that contains affiliate links.
- Health-related guides (motion sickness, using VR with glasses) state explicitly that they are not medical or optometric advice.
- Contact: westartmind@gmail.com
- Licensing terms for AI use are declared in machine-readable form at https://vr.ar/license.xml (RSL standard).

## Start here

- [VR Finder quiz (English)](https://vr.ar/): 7 questions, returns a personalised headset recommendation with a runner-up. Free, no account required.
- [VR Finder quiz (Spanish)](https://vr.ar/es/): the same quiz in Spanish.
- [What is virtual reality, and how does it work?](https://vr.ar/guides/what-is-virtual-reality): VR explained from scratch — how head tracking creates presence, what a first session actually feels like, real uses including FDA-cleared medical ones, entry costs, and common myths. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/que-es-la-realidad-virtual
- [What is augmented reality?](https://vr.ar/guides/what-is-augmented-reality): AR explained through the examples people already use daily, how phone tracking actually works, the FDA-cleared surgical use, and an honest account of what AR glasses cost and where they are sold. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/que-es-la-realidad-aumentada
- [VR vs AR vs MR vs XR: what each one actually is](https://vr.ar/guides/vr-vs-ar-vs-mr-explained): the difference between virtual, augmented and mixed reality, with everyday examples and an honest account of what can be bought today versus what remains a prototype. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/realidad-virtual-vs-aumentada

- [VR game compatibility catalogue](https://vr.ar/vr-game-compatibility): which platforms each of 90 VR games is actually available on, verified store by store. Open data under CC BY 4.0, machine-readable at https://vr.ar/data/vr-games.json. Platforms that were not verified for a given game are listed explicitly as unverified rather than assumed unavailable, so the absence of a platform never means "not available". Spanish: https://vr.ar/compatibilidad

- [Chrome extension: does that VR game work on your headset?](https://vr.ar/chrome-extension): a free Chrome extension by vr.ar that shows VR game compatibility with the user's headset while browsing Steam, the PlayStation Store or any page that mentions a game. Interface in English and Spanish, chosen from the browser's language. Catalogue of 90 games verified platform by platform; it says so when a game has not been verified rather than guessing. Spanish: https://vr.ar/extension

## Choosing a headset

- [Which VR headset to buy in 2026](https://vr.ar/guides/): the full comparison hub, organised by use case and budget. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/
- [Quest 3 vs Quest 3S](https://vr.ar/guides/quest-3-vs-quest-3s): what the extra US$250 buys — lenses, clarity and mixed-reality cameras — and who should choose which. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/quest-3-vs-quest-3s
- [Best VR for PS5](https://vr.ar/guides/best-vr-for-ps5): the PSVR2 is the only headset compatible with the PlayStation 5; when it is worth it and when a standalone Quest makes more sense. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/mejor-vr-para-ps5
- [What you actually need for PCVR](https://vr.ar/guides/what-you-need-for-pcvr): the PC, headset and connection required for PC-based VR, and what can be skipped at the start. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/que-necesitas-para-pcvr
- [Is the Pimax Crystal Light worth it?](https://vr.ar/guides/is-the-pimax-crystal-light-worth-it): an honest case for and against, aimed at sim racers and flight simmers chasing clarity. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/pimax-crystal-light-vale-la-pena

## Getting started and comfort

- [VR motion sickness: how to get your VR legs](https://vr.ar/guides/vr-motion-sickness): why VR causes nausea and the routine to adapt over a few weeks. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/mareos-realidad-virtual
- [Using VR with glasses](https://vr.ar/guides/using-vr-with-glasses): whether a Quest 3 can be worn over glasses, when correction is needed, and why prescription inserts usually win. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/vr-con-anteojos

## Using and maintaining a headset

- [How to clean Quest 3 lenses without ruining them](https://vr.ar/guides/how-to-clean-quest-3-lenses): Meta's official method, and the sunlight mistake that permanently burns the displays. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/como-limpiar-quest-3-lentes
- [Why your Quest 3 battery dies so fast](https://vr.ar/guides/quest-3-battery-life): roughly two hours is normal; which settings genuinely help and which accessory doubles playtime. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/bateria-quest-3-dura-poco
- [The best Quest 3 accessories](https://vr.ar/guides/best-quest-3-accessories): a short list in purchase order, and what can safely be skipped. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/mejores-accesorios-quest-3
- [How to connect a Quest 3 to a PC](https://vr.ar/guides/how-to-connect-quest-3-to-pc): wired Link and Air Link setup for SteamVR. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/como-conectar-quest-3-pc
- [How to connect a Quest 3 to a PC wirelessly](https://vr.ar/guides/how-to-connect-quest-3-to-pc-wirelessly): Air Link, Steam Link and Virtual Desktop, network tuning, and why "Air Link not working" is almost always the Wi-Fi. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/como-conectar-quest-3-pc-sin-cable

## Games

- [The best VR games (2026)](https://vr.ar/guides/best-vr-games-2026): a curated, scored list for Quest, PSVR2 and PC, with platform, price and comfort rating. Spanish: https://vr.ar/guias/mejores-juegos-vr-2026
